49001.meaning1: intent on Brahma's realm; fixated on the world of the gods

examples.text: mayhaṃ kho, bhante, evaṃ ahosi, ime kho brāhmaṇā brahmalok'ādhimuttā, yaṃnūn'āhaṃ dhanañ'jānissa brāhmaṇassa brahmānaṃ sahabyatāya maggaṃ deseyyan'ti.

49002.meaning1: reborn in the world of the gods; headed towards Brahma's realm

examples.text: tuvaṭaṃ cittaṃ samādhiyati, mukhavaṇṇo vippasīdati, asammūḷho kālaṃ karoti, uttari appaṭivijjhanto brahmalok'ūpago hoti.

49004.meaning1: rebirth in Brahma's realm; re-arising in the world of the gods

examples.text: taṃ kho pan'ānanda, kalyāṇaṃ vattaṃ na nibbidāya na virāgāya na nirodhāya na upasamāya na abhiññāya na sambodhāya na nibbānāya saṃvattati, yāva'd'eva brahmalok'ūpapattiyā.

49005.meaning1: companionship with Brahma; company of God
49005.meaning2: companionship with Brahma; company of God

examples.text: te vata, vāseṭṭha, tevijjā brāhmaṇā yaṃ na jānanti, yaṃ na passanti, tassa sahabyatāya maggaṃ desessanti. ayam'eva ujumaggo ayam'añjas'āyano niyyāniko niyyāti takkarassa brahmasabyatāyā'ti, n'etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.

49006.meaning1: holy; divine; equal to Brahma; like god almighty
49006.commentary: (ANa) evaṃ kho doṇa brāhmaṇo brahmasamo hotī'ti evaṃ brahmavihārehi samannāgatattā brāhmaṇo brahmasamo nāma hoti. (VINt) brahmasamenā'ti brahmattabhāvasamena.

examples.text: tuvañ'hi no brahmasamo'si saccaṃ, kathaṃ upapajjati brahmalokaṃ jutima.

49007.meaning1: companionship with Brahma; company of God
49007.meaning2: companionship with Brahma; company of God
49007.commentary: (DNa) takkarassa brahmasahabyatāyā'ti yo taṃ maggaṃ karoti paṭipajjati, tassa brahmunā saddhiṃ sahabhāvāya, ekaṭṭhāne pātubhāvāya gacchatī'ti attho.

examples.text: atha kho vāseṭṭho māṇavo evam'āha, ayam'eva ujumaggo, ayam'añjas'āyano niyyāniko niyyāti takkarassa brahmasahabyatāya, yv'āyaṃ akkhāto brāhmaṇena pokkharasātinā'ti.

49011.meaning1: with a deep voice; with a voice like god; twenty-eighth of the thirty-two marks of a great man
49011.commentary: (MNa) brahmassaro'ti aññe chinnassarā'pi bhinnassarā'pi kākassarā'pi honti, tathāgato pana mahābrahmuno sarasadisena sarena samannāgato.

examples.text: brahmassaro kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo karavikabhāṇī, idam'pi tassa bhoto gotamassa mahāpurisassa mahāpurisalakkhaṇaṃ bhavati.

49012.meaning1: fact of having a deep voice; fact of having the voice of god

49013.meaning1: with god's splendour; having the glory of Brahma; (comm) with a body like Brahma himself

examples.text: bhavañ'hi caṅkī abhirūpo dassanīyo pāsādiko paramāya vaṇṇapokkharatāya samannāgato brahmavaṇṇī brahmavaccasī akhudd'āvakāso dassanāya

49014.meaning1: with god's splendour; having the glory of Brahma; (comm) with a body like Brahma himself

examples.text: bhavañ'hi caṅkī abhirūpo dassanīyo pāsādiko paramāya vaṇṇapokkharatāya samannāgato brahmavaṇṇī brahmavacchasī akhudd'āvakāso dassanāya

49015.meaning2: ancient name of the city of Benares

49016.meaning1: like Brahma in appearance; god-like in aspect; (comm) surpassingly beautiful
49016.meaning2: like Brahma in appearance; surpassingly beautiful
49016.commentary: (MNa) brahmavaṇṇī'ti seṭṭhavaṇṇī, parisuddhavaṇṇesu'pi seṭṭhena suvaṇṇavaṇṇen'eva samannāgato'ti attho.

examples.text: bhavañ'hi caṅkī abhirūpo dassanīyo pāsādiko paramāya vaṇṇapokkharatāya samannāgato brahmavaṇṇī brahmavacchasī akhudd'āvakāso dassanāya

satta vassāni mettaṃ cittaṃ bhāvesiṃ. satta vassāni mettaṃ cittaṃ bhāvetvā satta saṃvaṭṭavivaṭṭakappe na'y'imaṃ lokaṃ punāgamāsiṃ. saṃvaṭṭamāne sud'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, loke ābhassar'ūpago homi, vivaṭṭamāne loke suññaṃ brahmavimānaṃ upapajjāmi.

49018.meaning1: divine dwelling; heavenly abode; sublime state
49018.meaning2: divine state of mind, name collectively given to mettā, karuṇā, muditā, and upekkhā
49018.commentary: (VISM) mettā, karuṇā, muditā, upekkhā'ti ime cattāro brahmavihārā
49018.notes: A collective term for the states of friendliness, compassion, appreciation and equanimity.

examples.text: so cattāro brahmavihāre bhāvetvā kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā brahmalok'ūpago ahosi.
ān'āpānassatisamādhiṃ sammā vadamāno vadeyya, ariyavihāro iti'pi, brahmavihāro iti'pi, tathāgatavihāro iti'pī'ti. paṭhamaṃ.

49019.meaning1: who delights in god; who relishes god; who is very happy with god

examples.text: ye pana, bhikkhu, tayā pubbe samaṇabrāhmaṇā lokasmiṃ… bhūtapasaṃsakā bhūt'ābhinandino, devapasaṃsakā dev'ābhinandino, pajāpatipasaṃsakā pajāpat'ābhinandino, brahmapasaṃsakā brahm'ābhinandino, te kāyassa bhedā pāṇupacchedā paṇīte kāye patiṭṭhitā.

tena kho pana samayena brahm'āyu brāhmaṇo mithilāyaṃ paṭivasati jiṇṇo vuḍḍho mahallako addhagato vayoanuppatto, vīsavassasatiko jātiyā, tiṇṇaṃ vedānaṃ pāragū sanighaṇḍukeṭubhānaṃ sākkharappabhedānaṃ itihāsapañcamānaṃ, padako, veyyākaraṇo, lok'āyata-mahāpurisalakkhaṇesu anavayo.

49024.meaning1: name of the Brahma who implored the Buddha to teach
49024.meaning2: name of the Brahma who implored the Buddha to teach

examples.text: parinibbute bhagavati saha parinibbānā brahmāsahampati imaṃ gāthaṃ abhāsi

49025.meaning1: with long and straight limbs; (comm) with straight limbs like a god; fifteenth of the thirty-two marks of a great man

examples.text: brahm'ujugatto kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo, idam'pi tassa bhoto gotamassa mahāpurisassa mahāpurisalakkhaṇaṃ bhavati.

49026.meaning2: fact of having long and straight limbs

49027.grammar: masc, instr sg of brahma, irreg

examples.text: nikkhaṃ jambonadass'eva, ko taṃ ninditum'arahati, devā'pi naṃ pasaṃsanti, brahmunā'pi pasaṃsito.
evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, uṇṇābhassa brāhmaṇassa tathāgate saddhā niviṭṭhā mūlajātā patiṭṭhitā daḷhā asaṃhāriyā samaṇena vā brāhmaṇena vā devena vā mārena vā brahmunā vā kenaci vā lokasmiṃ.

49028.grammar: masc, dat sg of brahma, irreg
49028.meaning1: for god; for Brahma; to god

examples.text: tena kho pana, bhikkhave, samayena bakassa brahmuno evarūpaṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ uppannaṃ hoti, idaṃ niccaṃ, idaṃ dhuvaṃ, idaṃ sassataṃ, idaṃ kevalaṃ

49029.grammar: masc, gen sg of brahma, irreg

examples.text: iti h'idaṃ mārassa ca anālapanatāya brahmuno ca abhinimantanatāya, tasmā imassa veyyākaraṇassa brahmanimantanikaṃ't'eva adhivacanan'ti.
mahābrahmuno'pi kho, bhikkhave, atth'eva aññathattaṃ atthi vipariṇāmo. evaṃ passaṃ, bhikkhave, sutavā ariyasāvako tasmim'pi nibbindati. tasmiṃ nibbindanto agge virajjati, pag'eva hīnasmiṃ.

49030.meaning1: rebirth as Brahma; re-arising as god

examples.text: dvāsattati gotama puññakammā, vasavattino jātijaraṃ atītā, ayam'antimā vedagū brahm'upapatti, asm'ābhijappanti janā anekā'ti.

49031.meaning1: Brahma's observance day; epithet of recollection of the Buddha
49031.commentary: (ANa) brahm'uposathaṃ upavasatī'ti brahmā vuccati sammāsambuddho, tassa guṇ'ānussaraṇavasena ayaṃ uposatho brahm'uposatho nāma, taṃ upavasati.

examples.text: tassa tathāgataṃ anussarato cittaṃ pasīdati, pāmojjaṃ uppajjati, ye cittassa upakkilesā te pahīyanti. ayaṃ vuccati, visākhe, ariyasāvako brahm'uposathaṃ upavasati, brahmunā saddhiṃ saṃvasati, brahmañ'c'assa ārabbha cittaṃ pasīdati, pāmojjaṃ uppajjati, ye cittassa upakkilesā te pahīyanti.

49032.grammar: masc, voc sg of brahma, irreg

examples.text: handa carahi te, mārisa, passa antaradhāyāmī'ti. handa carahi me tvaṃ, brahme, antaradhāyassu, sace visahasī'ti.
anusāsa brahme karuṇāyamāno, vivekadhammaṃ yam'ahaṃ vijaññaṃ, yath'āhaṃ ākāso'va abyāpajjamāno, idh'eva santo asito careyyaṃ.

49033.meaning1: Brahman; priest; man of the Brahman caste

examples.text: na jaccā vasalo hoti, na jaccā hoti brāhmaṇo, kammunā vasalo hoti, kammunā hoti brāhmaṇo'ti.
imāni cattāri ariyasaccānī'ti, bhikkhave, mayā dhammo desito aniggahito asaṃkiliṭṭho anupavajjo appaṭikuṭṭho samaṇehi brāhmaṇehi viññūhī'ti. iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ idam'etaṃ paṭicca vuttan'ti.
tass'īdha diṭṭhe va sute mute vā, pakappitā n'atthi aṇū'pi saññā, taṃ brāhmaṇaṃ diṭṭhim'anādiyānaṃ, ken'īdha lokasmiṃ vikappayeyya.
aham'asmi, bhikkhave, brāhmaṇo yācayogo sadā payatapāṇi antimadehadharo anuttaro bhisakko sallakatto.
chinda sotaṃ parakkamma, kāme panuda brāhmaṇa, saṅkhārānaṃ khayaṃ ñatvā, akataññū'si brāhmaṇa.
divā tapati ādicco, rattim'ābhāti candimā, sannaddho khattiyo tapati, jhāyī tapati brāhmaṇo, atha sabbam'ahorattiṃ, buddho tapati tejasā.
santi kho pana, bhante, imasmiṃ rājakule khattiyakaññā'pi brāhmaṇakaññā'pi gahapatikaññā'pi, tās'āhaṃ issar'ādhipaccaṃ kāremi.

seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, khattiyakaññā vā brāhmaṇakaññā vā gahapatikaññā vā pannarasavass'uddesikā vā soḷasavass'uddesikā vā, n'ātidīghā n'ātirassā n'ātikisā n'ātithūlā n'ātikāḷī n'āccodātā paramā sā, bhikkhave, tasmiṃ samaye subhā vaṇṇanibhā'ti?

49037.meaning1: which makes one a Brahman; which should be done by a Brahman
49037.commentary: (MNa) ye dhammā samaṇakaraṇā ca brāhmaṇakaraṇā cā'ti ye dhammā samādāya paripūritā samitapāpasamaṇañ'ca bāhitapāpabrāhmaṇañ'ca karontī'ti attho… ettha pana samaṇena kattabbadhammā vuttā. te'pi ca samaṇakaraṇā honti'y'eva. idha pana hir'ottapp'ādi-vasena desanā vitthāritā.

examples.text: tesaṃ vo, bhikkhave, evaṃsamaññānaṃ sataṃ evaṃpaṭiññānaṃ sataṃ ye dhammā samaṇakaraṇā ca brāhmaṇakaraṇā ca te dhamme samādāya vattissāma, evaṃ no ayaṃ amhākaṃ samaññā ca saccā bhavissati paṭiññā ca bhūtā.

49038.meaning1: which makes one a Brahman; which Brahmans do
49038.commentary: (DNa) ye dhammā brāhmaṇakārakā'ti ettha pañcasīla-dasakusalakammapatha-bhedā dhammā brāhmaṇakārakā'ti veditabbā, tabbiparītā abrāhmaṇakārakā.

examples.text: evam'eva kho, vāseṭṭha, tevijjā brāhmaṇā ye dhammā brāhmaṇakārakā te dhamme pahāya vattamānā

taṃ kiṃ maññasi, assalāyana, idha brāhmaṇakumāro khattiyakaññāya saddhiṃ saṃvāsaṃ kappeyya, tesaṃ saṃvāsam'anvāya putto jāyetha, yo so brāhmaṇakumārena khattiyakaññāya putto uppanno, siyā so mātu'pi sadiso pitu'pi sadiso, khattiyo'ti'pi vattabbo brāhmaṇo'ti'pi vattabbo'ti?

evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, brāhmaṇakulā ce'pi agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito hoti, so ca tathāgatappaveditaṃ dhammavinayaṃ āgamma, evaṃ mettaṃ karuṇaṃ muditaṃ upekkhaṃ bhāvetvā labhati ajjhattaṃ vūpasamaṃ.
kulaṃ nāma cattāri kulāni, khattiyakulaṃ, brāhmaṇakulaṃ, vessakulaṃ, suddakulaṃ.

49042.meaning1: from a Brahman family; belonging to a Brahman household

examples.text: atha kho bhagavā vāseṭṭhaṃ āmantesi, tumhe khv'attha, vāseṭṭha, brāhmaṇajaccā brāhmaṇakulīnā brāhmaṇakulā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitā, kacci vo, vāseṭṭha, brāhmaṇā na akkosanti na paribhāsantī'ti?

49043.meaning1: group of Brahmans; crowd of Brahmans
49043.meaning2: group of Brahmans; crowd of Brahmans

examples.text: atha kho assalāyano māṇavo mahatā brāhmaṇagaṇena saddhiṃ yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi. sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdi.

49044.commentary: (ITIa) brāhmaṇagahapatikā'ti brāhmaṇā c'eva gahapatikā ca. ṭhapetvā brāhmaṇe ye keci agāraṃ ajjhāvasantā idha gahapatikā'ti veditabbā.

examples.text: brāhmaṇagahapatikānam'pi tasmiṃ samaye na phāsu hoti atiyātuṃ vā niyyātuṃ vā bāhirāni vā kamm'antāni paṭivekkhituṃ.

assosuṃ kho mithileyyakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā, samaṇo khalu, bho, gotamo sakyaputto sakyakulā pabbajito videhesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ pañcamattehi bhikkhusatehi mithilaṃ anuppatto

49045.commentary: (MNa) brāhmaṇagāmo'ti brāhmaṇānaṃ samosaraṇagāmo'pi brāhmaṇagāmo'ti vuccati brāhmaṇānaṃ bhogagāmo'pi. idha samosaraṇagāmo adhippeto. (SNa) brāhmaṇagāme'ti… brāhmaṇā pan'ettha sambahulā paṭivasanti, brāhmaṇabhogo eva vā so. tasmā brāhmaṇagāmo'ti vuccati.

examples.text: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā magadhesu viharati dakkhiṇāgirismiṃ ekanāḷāyaṃ brāhmaṇagāme.
evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā mallesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ yena thūṇaṃ nāma mallānaṃ brāhmaṇagāmo tadavasari.

49046.meaning1: outcaste of a Brahman; low caste Brahman

examples.text: sabbakammehi jīvikaṃ kappetī'ti kho, doṇa, tasmā brāhmaṇo brāhmaṇacaṇḍālo'ti vuccati. evaṃ kho, doṇa, brāhmaṇo brāhmaṇacaṇḍālo hoti.

49047.meaning1: Brahman by birth; of Brahman descent

examples.text: atha kho bhagavā vāseṭṭhaṃ āmantesi, tumhe khv'attha, vāseṭṭha, brāhmaṇajaccā brāhmaṇakulīnā brāhmaṇakulā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitā, kacci vo, vāseṭṭha, brāhmaṇā na akkosanti na paribhāsantī'ti?
esā hīnā nāma jāti. ukkaṭṭhā nāma jāti, khattiyajāti, brāhmaṇajāti. esā ukkaṭṭhā nāma jāti.

49049.meaning1: terror of the Brahman Tissa; event in Sri Lankan history

examples.text: brāhmaṇatissabhaye pana bhātaragāmavāsino nāgattheriyā anārocetvā'va palāyiṃsu. therī paccūsasamaye ativiya appanigghoso gāmo, upadhāretha tāvā'ti daharabhikkhuniyo āha.

49050.meaning1: Brahman girl; maiden of Brahman caste

examples.text: lohitañ'ca taṃ candanañcā'ti lohitacandanaṃ, brāhmaṇī ca sā dārikā cā'ti brāhmaṇadārikā, khattiyā ca sā kaññā cā'ti khattiyakaññā.
kammadhārayasaññe ca samāse itthiyaṃ tuly'ādhikaraṇe pade pubbe bhāsitapum'itthī ce, pumā'va daṭṭhabbā. brāhmaṇadārikā, khattiyakaññā, khattiyakumārikā.
tena kho pana samayena sambahulā kosalakā ca brāhmaṇadūtā māgadhakā ca brāhmaṇadūtā vesāliyaṃ paṭivasanti kenaci'd'eva karaṇīyena.

49053.meaning1: Brahman principle; Brahman practice; Brahman custom

examples.text: eta'r'ahi, bhikkhave, sunakhā sunakhiṃ'y'eva gacchanti, no asunakhiṃ. ayaṃ, bhikkhave, paṭhamo porāṇo brāhmaṇadhammo eta'r'ahi sunakhesu sandissati, no brāhmaṇesu.

rakkhass'etaṃ, māgaṇḍiya, vācaṃ, rakkhass'etaṃ, māgaṇḍiya, vācaṃ. bahū hi tassa bhoto gotamassa khattiyapaṇḍitā'pi brāhmaṇapaṇḍitā'pi gahapatipaṇḍitā'pi samaṇapaṇḍitā'pi abhippasannā vinītā ariye ñāye dhamme kusale'ti.
puna capar'āhaṃ, bho, passāmi idh'ekacce brāhmaṇapaṇḍite nipuṇe kataparappavāde vālavedhirūpe te bhindantā maññe caranti paññāgatena diṭṭhigatāni.

atha kho aññataro brāhmaṇaparibbājako yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā … ekam'antaṃ nisinno kho so brāhmaṇaparibbājako bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, sandiṭṭhiko dhammo sandiṭṭhiko dhammo'ti, bho gotama, vuccati.

49061.meaning1: assembly of Brahmans; gathering of Brahmans; meeting of Brahmans

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, sīha, dāyako dānapati yaṃ yadeva parisaṃ upasaṅkamati, yadi khattiyaparisaṃ yadi brāhmaṇaparisaṃ yadi gahapatiparisaṃ yadi samaṇaparisaṃ, visārado'va upasaṅkamati amaṅkubhūto.
bhāsitapume'ti kim'atthaṃ? brāhmaṇabandhu ca sā bhariyā cā'ti brāhmaṇabandhubhariyā.

49063.meaning1: circle of Brahmans; group of Brahmans

examples.text: iti kho, vāseṭṭha, evam'etassa brāhmaṇamaṇḍalassa porāṇena aggaññena akkharena abhinibbatti ahosi tesaṃ'y'eva sattānaṃ, anaññesaṃ sadisānaṃ'y'eva no asadisānaṃ dhammen'eva, no adhammena.

49064.meaning1: wealthy man of the Brahman caste
49064.commentary: (SNa) yesaṃ brāhmaṇānaṃ asītikoṭidhanaṃ nihitaṃ hoti, diyaḍḍho kahāpaṇakumbho valañjan'atthāya gehamajjhe rāsiṃ katvā ṭhapito hoti, te brāhmaṇamahāsālā nāma.

examples.text: ye'pi te, mahārāja, brāhmaṇamahāsālā aḍḍhā mahaddhanā mahābhogā pahūtajātarūparajatā pahūtavitt'ūpakaraṇā pahūtadhanadhaññā, tesam'pi jātānaṃ n'atthi aññatra jarāmaraṇā.

idh'āhaṃ, bhante, aḍḍakaraṇe nisinno passāmi khattiyamahāsāle'pi brāhmaṇamahāsāle'pi gahapatimahāsāle'pi aḍḍhe mahaddhane mahābhoge pahūtajātarūparajate pahūtavitt'ūpakaraṇe pahūtadhanadhaññe kāmahetu kāmanidānaṃ kām'ādhikaraṇaṃ sampajānamusā bhāsante.

idh'ānanda, ekacco ucce kule paccājāto hoti, khattiyamahāsālakule vā brāhmaṇamahāsālakule vā gahapatimahāsālakule vā, aḍḍhe mahaddhane mahābhoge pahūtajātarūparajate pahūtavitt'ūpakaraṇe pahūtadhanadhaññe.

49066.meaning1: we are holy men; we are Brahmans

examples.text: mayañ'hi pubbe assamaṇā'va samānā samaṇ'amhā'ti paṭijānimha, abrāhmaṇā'va samānā brāhmaṇ'amhā'ti paṭijānimha, anarahanto'va samānā arahant'amhā'ti paṭijānimha.

tena kho pana samayena tesaṃ aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ sannisinnānaṃ sannipatitānaṃ ayamantarā kathā udapādi, iti'pi brāhmaṇasaccāni, iti'pi brāhmaṇasaccānī'ti. atha kho bhagavā yena te paribbājakā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
tena kho pana samayena nānāverajjakānaṃ brāhmaṇānaṃ pañcamattāni brāhmaṇasatāni sāvatthiyaṃ paṭivasanti kenaci'd'eva karaṇīyena.

49070.meaning1: considered to be Brahmans (among); deemed Brahman

examples.text: niṭṭhite kho pan'ānanda, dhamme pāsāde niṭṭhitāya dhammāya ca pokkharaṇiyā rājā mahāsudassano ye tena samayena samaṇesu vā samaṇasammatā brāhmaṇesu vā brāhmaṇasammatā, te sabbakāmehi santappetvā dhammaṃ pāsādaṃ abhiruhi.
